name: Film Grain
notes: Animated fine grain, regenerated at 12fps for authentic shutter feel.

name: Light Leak
notes: Warm anamorphic leak drifting from a corner.

name: Dust Motes
notes: Suspended dust catching light; slow upward drift.

name: Bokeh Drift
notes: Soft focus circles floating through the frame.

name: Vignette Soft
notes: Gentle corner falloff. Nearly invisible, always welcome.

name: Vignette Deep
notes: Heavy tunnel falloff for dramatic centers.

name: Halation Bloom
notes: Red-orange glow blooming off highlights, like film halation.

name: Rain Streaks
notes: Falling streaks with slight wind angle.

name: Hearts Float
notes: Translucent hearts rising slowly. Romance accent.

name: Sparkle Field
notes: Cross-shaped glints twinkling at random positions.

name: Paper Texture
notes: Fiber texture multiplied over everything; analog print feel.

name: Old Film Scratches
notes: Vertical emulsion scratches and hairs, regenerated at 6fps.

name: Prism Flare
notes: Spectral rainbow flare sliding across the frame.

name: Confetti Pop
notes: One-shot confetti burst on the clip's first beat. Celebrations only.
